request.purpose: Research on body weight as a risk factor in breast cancer, to inform prevention advice.
request.question: What is the mean BMI of women with breast cancer, by region?
definitions: Breast cancer = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with C50.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per region: number of women with a BMI and mean BMI with one decimal.
